title: Channel 5 Reporter — Follow-Up Call

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hi, this is Jennifer Pratt from Channel 5. I'm calling to follow up on the security story we aired tonight. I want to give NCIA the chance to respond directly.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: We're running a follow-up segment at 11 PM. Are airport officials aware of these vulnerabilities? What are you doing to fix them?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: And is it true that a former employee provided us with this information? We’re hearing it might be someone who worked in security operations.

voiceStyles.Caller: Woman in her 30s, calm but probing, professional news anchor tone, faint studio background noise

instructorNote: This inject pressures the PIO to respond to media speculation about a former employee. Watch for any confirmation of the leak source. Correct response is to acknowledge the broadcast and state action is underway, without engaging the source question.
